mentions.description: A Graphviz dot substitute written in pure Rust that renders graphs with predictable, stable layout, edge routing that avoids overlapping labels, dark and light mode styling via Tailwind CSS, interactivity implemented in pure CSS, and markdown support for descriptions.

mentions.name: disposition
mentions.description: A GraphViz replacement for generating graph diagrams, written in Rust. It supports stable node positions and styling, including default styles and dark mode styles. Planned features include edge labels, images in nodes, generating diagrams for different screen sizes, and possibly LSP support.
mentions.problem: The hardest part is calculating coordinates for edges: ranking/positioning nodes when edges connect nodes of different nesting levels, and ensuring edges don't overlap with nodes or with each other.
mentions.source_excerpt:
